items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: I was with Toliver Smutsets when I met her. She had the band on the number one show, and this show that I was with was number two.

ctx.x: There's one thing, excuse me for interrupting again, but since you're talking about your wife coming up here with you and all, when were you married and-
Well, I was with Toliver Smutsets when I met her. She had the band on the number one show, and this show that I was with was number two.
Where did the wife come from?
